newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SGB to decide Tractebel-Powerfin merger in March.
newsitem.headline: SGB to decide Tractebel-Powerfin merger in March.

text.p: Belgian holding company Societe Generale de Belgique (SGB) will decide on a possible merger of its units Tractebel SA and Powerfin at the end of March, SGB chairman Etienne Davignon said on Thursday.
"We prefer to take the decision once we have approved Tractebel's 1996 accounts at our board meeting at the end of March," Davignon told Reuters in an interview.
He declined to say whether it was already certain that the merger between the two utility holding companies would go ahead.

Tractebel and its controlling shareholder SGB have been looking into the possibility of a full merger between Tractebel and Tractebel unit Powerfin since September, when SGB increased its stake in Tractebel to 65 percent.
Powerfin is the vehicle which spearheads Tractebel's expansion into utility services abroad.
SGB is 62 percent held by French Cie. de Suez.
